title: Task work item
description: The shovel-ready altitude (portfolio ADR-0015): a narrow, concrete goal measured by a test set (unit/integration/performance — TDD). The BODY is the contract — the goal and the signed test-set description (shape, coverage, deliberate gaps) live there and are what the approval hash pins; frontmatter is state, including the execution telemetry Measure reads (this frontmatter replaces forge PR labels as tuesday's carrier). Sign-off (draft -> ready) is the human seat confirming the test set; done is set by the mechanical merge door only.

id.description: Stable opaque page identifier (ULID, tool-generated). Links target this, not the path.

status.description: Work-item lifecycle, aligned to conduit workitem::Status (transitions enforced by conduit's doors; done is the merge door's alone)

created.description: RFC 3339 timestamp the task was created

story.description: Id (preferred) or slug of the parent story — sign-off flows downhill through this edge, done flows uphill

effort.description: Effort bucket from the closed set (como-contract EFFORT_LABELS minus the label prefix) — the field tuesday prices, carried here instead of a forge PR label

branch.description: Working branch in the project's internal repo, written by the claim door

claimed_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp the claim door started the clock — work_ms is measured from here at the merge door

merge_commit.description: The merged commit in the project's internal repo, written by the merge door when it sets done — the graph edge from priced work to landed code

work_ms.description: Execution wall-clock milliseconds, written by the doors — the raw quantity tuesday prices

by.description: The human seat that signed off the test set

content_sha256.description: sha256 of the page body exactly as signed — any body edit breaks it and bounces the item to draft. Written only by conduit's sign-off door, never by the harness (suite convention, portfolio ADR-0015).

approval.description: Sign-off seal. Its presence is what makes an item executable; only the owning door writes it.

x-wiki-types.task: Work-item task: a shovel-ready goal measured by its signed test set
